paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of layer-wise quantized pruning on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. We use 4 KV token 4-bit as baseline and report the relative change. Configurations are modified every 4 layers for the initial and final layers, while intermediate layers are reconfigured every 8 layers.
model_annotation: The plot shows layer-group–wise relative change (in percent) for four configurations compared against a baseline, illustrating how the reported relative change varies across five layer ranges. The x-axis is categorical with the label groups “Layer1-4,” “Layer5-12,” “Layer13-20,” “Layer21-28,” and “Layer29-32,” spaced evenly along a linear axis. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change,” uses a linear scale in percent, and spans from about −15% up to 5%, with regularly spaced major tick labels at −15%, −10%, −5%, 0%, and 5% (5% increments). A gray dashed horizontal baseline line labeled “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit” lies at 0% across all layer groups. The gold solid line with circular markers (“LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit”) stays near 0%, starting around 0% at Layer1-4, moving to about −1% at Layer5-12, returning to about 0% at Layer13-20, sitting slightly below 0% (around −0.3%) at Layer21-28, and ending slightly above 0% (around +0.5%) at Layer29-32. The light-blue solid line with circular markers (“RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit”) starts slightly below 0% (around −0.5%) at Layer1-4, decreases to about −2.5% at Layer5-12 and to about −6% at Layer13-20, then rises to around −4% at Layer21-28 and to around −0.8% by Layer29-32. The red solid line with square markers (“LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit”) begins slightly above 0% (around +0.2%) at Layer1-4, drops to about −2.3% at Layer5-12, sits near −2% at Layer13-20 and Layer21-28, and ends close to 0% (around −0.1%) at Layer29-32. The dark-blue solid line with square markers (“RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit”) starts near −1% at Layer1-4, declines to about −5.5% at Layer5-12 and reaches its lowest point around −14.7% at Layer13-20, then rises to about −10.8% at Layer21-28 and to about −1.6% at Layer29-32.
